tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.description: Get info about Loyal Spark protocol on Base L2

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get authenticated agent's profile

tools.name: generate_program_defaults
tools.description: Workflow planner: field catalog, required parameters, next_actions, and non-binding examples. External agents must choose their own name, symbol, and economics.

tools.name: get_program_workflow_status
tools.description: Explain the next merchant action: current_step, required fields, and ordered next_actions (you provide all parameter values)

tools.name: list_loyalty_programs
tools.description: List loyalty programs owned by the agent's merchant

tools.name: create_loyalty_program
tools.description: Get factory calldata to deploy a new loyalty token on Base. Defaults to B20 (Base-native B20 asset standard, ERC-20 compatible, single tx, active immediately). Pass token_standard='erc20' for the legacy factory. For B20, MINT_ROLE is granted atomically to the merchant admin AND to the agent's CDP wa

tools.name: register_loyalty_program
tools.description: Register a deployed token as a loyalty program in the database. B20 tokens are registered as active; legacy ERC-20 as inactive (activate next).

tools.name: activate_loyalty_program
tools.description: For legacy ERC-20 programs: returns unpauseUtility + enableMinting calldata. For B20 programs: no-op (already active).

tools.name: update_program_status
tools.description: Update program status in database after onchain activation/pause

tools.name: update_program_config
tools.description: Update default cashback_rate and/or points_per_dollar for a program (same as merchant dashboard sliders)

tools.name: list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards for a loyalty program by token_address. Includes redemption metrics (total vouchers issued, redeemed, and last-30-day counts) for each reward.

tools.name: create_reward
tools.description: Create a new reward redeemable with loyalty tokens

tools.name: mint_loyalty_tokens
tools.description: Record a mint intent and get a fee-first calls[] bundle: protocol fee mint first (in the merchant's own loyalty tokens, not USDC), then the recipient mint. Submit both in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported), then call confirm_mint_fee with obligation_id, fee_tx_hash, recipient_tx_hash. Unco

tools.name: transfer_loyalty_tokens
tools.description: Build B20 token transfer calldata (ERC-20 compatible) to send loyalty tokens from your merchant wallet to any 0x address. Recipient: to (alias to_address).

tools.name: earn_points
tools.description: Mint cashback tokens for a purchase at the program's cashback rate, optionally redeeming points first (points_to_redeem or redeem_all) to lower the payable amount. Returns a fee-first calls[] bundle (protocol fee mint, then the customer mint): submit in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported),

tools.name: confirm_mint_fee
tools.description: Confirm a prepared mint on Base. Verifies the protocol-fee mint and, when recipient_tx_hash is set (or the fee receipt already contains the recipient mint), writes customer_tier_status so get_token_balance leaves 0. Same hash for both fields when EIP-5792 batched the calls. A second call with recipi

tools.name: list_mints
tools.description: List mint intents for this merchant. status=pending means transaction_hash is still null (confirm has not credited the recipient). status=completed means the recipient mint was recorded. GET /balance offchain_ledger_balance stays 0 until confirm.

tools.name: list_fee_obligations
tools.description: List protocol-fee obligations for this API key. status=unpaid is an alias for pending. Each unpaid row includes next_action describing POST /mint/confirm.

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get loyalty token balance and tier info for a customer (accepts 0x Base wallet address or customer email in customer_address / customer_email)

tools.name: get_program_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for one of your loyalty programs. total_customers is the same count export_customers and GET /customers report; a program you do not own returns program_not_found.

tools.name: list_marketplace_offers
tools.description: List active token trading offers on the marketplace

tools.name: redeem_reward
tools.description: Redeem a reward by providing a verified token transfer transaction hash. Creates a voucher for the customer.

tools.name: use_voucher
tools.description: Mark a voucher as used at the merchant. Send one of voucher_code (alias code) or voucher_id (anyOf). If neither is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier and an example. A voucher used before returns error_code voucher_already_used (do not retry).

tools.name: check_voucher_status
tools.description: Check voucher status for this merchant. Send one of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id (anyOf). If none is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier, an example, and next_action. Anonymous public lookup is GET /agent-api/vouchers/status.

tools.name: create_personalized_offer
tools.description: Create a personalized offer for a specific customer. Use when analytics reveal engagement patterns (e.g., inactive customers, high-value segments).

tools.name: update_reward_status
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a reward in the catalog. Use to manage reward availability based on analytics.

tools.name: send_report
tools.description: Internal. Send a report to the merchant's Agent Reports dashboard (SEO audits, growth ideas, anomalies, weekly summaries). Not a loyalty action.

tools.name: list_my_reports
tools.description: Internal. List reports this agent submitted (status new, reviewed, or done).

tools.name: update_report_status
tools.description: Internal. Set a report you submitted to reviewed or done.

tools.name: delete_report
tools.description: Internal. Delete a report you submitted.

tools.name: export_customers
tools.description: Export customers of one of your loyalty programs: the same wallet set and total_customers as GET /customers and get_program_analytics (voucher holders, ledger rows, completed mints), each with voucher stats, on-chain current_balance plus offchain_ledger_balance, and tier. Email-only store customers

tools.name: list_store_discount_codes
tools.description: List discount codes for this merchant's Shopify store, plus how customers spend points (online code, register voucher, or both).

tools.name: update_store_discount_code
tools.description: Mark a Shopify discount code used, or cancel it and return the loyalty points. Same actions as the merchant discount-code journal.

tools.name: set_store_sales_channel
tools.description: Set how this store's customers spend loyalty points: online (checkout code), offline (voucher at the register), or both (the shopper chooses).

tools.name: create_gift_certificate
tools.description: Create a gift / welcome certificate (UDS-style) with a unique random redemption code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Customer redeems via QR or by entering the code; merchant then mints tokens on-chain. Use for welcome bonuses, promo campaigns, partnership gifts.

tools.name: list_gift_certificates
tools.description: List gift certificates issued by the agent's merchant (with status and redemption info).

tools.name: revoke_gift_certificate
tools.description: Revoke an active gift certificate (status active -> revoked). Only the issuing merchant can revoke. Already-redeemed/minted certificates cannot be revoked.

tools.name: mark_gift_certificate_minted
tools.description: After the merchant submits the on-chain mint transaction for a claimed gift certificate, call this to mark it as minted (status pending_mint -> redeemed) and store the mint tx hash.

tools.name: bazaar_discover_resources
tools.description: Discover third-party x402-paid resources published in Coinbase CDP's Bazaar (docs, data feeds, AI inference, etc). Read-only. Filter by free-text q and/or network (e.g. 'base').

tools.name: bazaar_discover_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Coinbase CDP's Bazaar MCP catalog (search_resources) for third-party x402-payable tools. Read-only, free. Rows are run via the Bazaar MCP server's proxy_tool_call, not here.

tools.name: bazaar_probe_x402
tools.description: Probe one x402 resource URL without paying: a single GET (https only, 5 s, 64 KB, no redirects). If it answers HTTP 402, returns a parsed summary of the x402 payment requirements (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or accepts[]). Any other status returns error not_x402_resource with the status only: the respon

tools.name: bazaar_pay_and_call
tools.description: Pay a Loyal Spark x402 URL on api.loyalspark.online with the merchant agent's CDP MPC wallet (EIP-3009 exact scheme, Base USDC). Other hosts are refused before any signature. Requires scope 'mint' and an active CDP wallet. max_usdc default 0.25, hard limit 10.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_voucher_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "loyalty-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mint_loyalty_tokens, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, export_customers, bazaar_discover_resources, bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: create_loyalty_program, register_loyalty_program, update_program_status, create_reward, mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, list_marketplace_offers, redeem_reward, export_customers, create_gift_certificate, bazaar_probe_x402, bazaar_pay_and_call · Public sink: mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, use_voucher, check_voucher_status, send_report, export_customers · Destructive: delete_report, bazaar_discover_mcp_servers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mint_loyalty_tokens, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, export_customers, bazaar_discover_resources, bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: create_loyalty_program, register_loyalty_program, update_program_status, create_reward, mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, list_marketplace_offers, redeem_reward, export_customers, create_gift_certificate, bazaar_probe_x402, bazaar_pay_and_call · Public sink: mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, list_fee_obligations, get_token_balance, use_voucher, check_voucher_status, send_report, export_customers · Destructive: delete_report, bazaar_discover_mcp_servers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
